'''Semasalli''' was a [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] crew member of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Woebegone]]''.

==Biography==
[[File:DarthPlagueisHS-SWI130.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Plagueis, Semasalli's murderer.]]
In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Semasalli was present when [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] on its journey from [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] was killed by Plagueis, Semasalli joined his fellow crewmembers in attacking the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. During the fighting, Semasalli was [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]], [[Cho sun/Legends|losing his left arm]] at the shoulder. He was rendered unconscious after the battle, and was aboard when Plagueis ordered the ship to be destroyed.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Semasalli is a supporting character introduced in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by [[James Luceno]]. In the novel, Semasalli has but a scant few lines and is killed early on, though this occurs outside the narrative.
